# Asterisk GPLv2 Source Code Offer

OneDoor distributes unmodified Asterisk binaries inside its container
via the Alpine Linux package repository (`apk add asterisk`).

Asterisk is licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 (GPLv2).

In accordance with GPLv2 Section 3, the complete corresponding source code
for Asterisk is publicly available from the following locations:

- Asterisk upstream source:
  https://github.com/asterisk/asterisk

- Alpine Linux Asterisk package source:
  https://git.alpinelinux.org/aports/tree/community/asterisk

This written offer ensures that all recipients of this software can obtain
the complete corresponding source code for Asterisk as required by GPLv2.
